sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajeev Misra,J.

Heard Mr. R.K. Singh, the learned counsel for applicant, the learned A.G.A. for State and Mr. Arvind Singh Sengar, the learned counsel representing first informant opposite party 4.
Perused the record.

Applicant Golu Sahani, who is a charge sheeted accused and alleges himself to be husband of the prosecutrix has filed present application under Section 482 Cr. P. C. with the following prayer:-
"It is, therefore, Most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to direct the court of Additional Session Judge-8 (Pocso) Act, Ballia to release the wife of the applicant namely Rinki Sahani from the custody of Nari Niketan Nidharia, Ballia who has been under custody in Case Crime No. 77 of 2024, State Versus Golu Sahani, under Section 363, 366, 376, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 5L/6 Pocso Act, Police Station Bansdih, District Ballia, and/or pass such or to pass Golu Sahani vs State Of U.P. And 4 Others on 7 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/165594553/

entities.text: court of Additional Session Judge-8 (Pocso) Act, Ballia
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Golu Sahani vs State Of U.P. And 4 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 such other and further order which this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper under the circumstances of the case."

After some arguments, the learned counsel for applicant fairly submits that there are inherent mistakes in the present application, which cannot be cured by filing an amendment application or a supplementary affidavit.
He, therefore, submits that present application be dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to file fresh.
Prayer made by the learned counsel for applicant is not opposed by the learned A.G.A. or the learned counsel representing first informant opposite party 4.
In view of above, this application is, accordingly, dismissed as withdrawn with liberty aforesaid.

Interim order, if any, shall stand vacated.
Order Date :- 7.2.2025/HSM  Golu Sahani vs State Of U.P. And 4 Others on 7 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/165594553/
